findings.title: Launcher recovery blocks the shared ordinary continuity cadence
findings.evidence: The worker calls runtime.reconcile_all, then waits for the full launcher pass with Future.result(). That pass iterates policy projects sequentially and awaits publication/preparation/executor I/O. Independent probe held recovery pending and observed exactly one ordinary tick across 24 configured intervals; cleanup released the pending coroutine and worker exited normally.
findings.impact: An unavailable launcher operation delays unrelated managed graph recovery, outbox progression and future ordinary ticks. Exception isolation and a responsive ASGI loop do not isolate this shared worker delay.
findings.requested_change: Schedule at most one launcher recovery on the owning event loop independently of ordinary continuity ticks; observe completion and errors without waiting in that worker; perform explicit bounded shutdown cleanup. Test that normal ticks continue while recovery is pending and that no overlapping recoveries start.

source_review: Read all thirteen changed files and relevant surrounding importer, continuity, process supervisor and transport code.
Fresh current grants bind authenticated user/chat/project/action. Prepare does not grant Start. Pending Stop uses retained current Stop permission before source/preparation checks.

READY is required before engine activation; ACCEPTED must match exact initial assignments and original session before Running. Stored READY, ACCEPTED and STOPPED are revalidated on decode/update/recovery/finalization.

Loopback executor adapter rejects external hosts, paths, userinfo and redirects, disables environment proxies, resolves bearer credentials through the configured secret reference and bounds strict JSON responses.

Publication, preparation, Start and Stop share the operation lock. Shared project reservation blocks legacy/new import races. Recovery lineage retains exact launcher context and does not activate manual retries.

Stop fence and cancellation are symmetrically bound to control evidence. Explicit old IDs cannot create new graph/review/recovery/repair/scope effects after stop; exact prior accepted acknowledgements remain historical.

Cancellation reconstructs and validates prior runtime, preserves outcomes/reviews/history, proves resource retirement, and releases only the owner slot. The stop-specific PREPARED native claim preserves launch/restart fencing.

tests.suite: independent stdin unittest using disposable local Git fixture
assertions: Current Stop grant completes pending cleanup after prepare revocation and source ref policy change.
Foreign-session STOPPED updates and decoded records are rejected, without persisting the receipt.
ACCEPTED assignment IDs must match actual activation.
Removing the runtime stop marker while control retains it is rejected.
Actual stopped runtime schema/invariants pass; forged before-state hash is rejected.

tests.suite: independent exact main-loop isolated asyncio probe

limitations: No native child-process tests were run by this reviewer to avoid fixture port collisions; supervisor changes were inspected.
No live Telegram Bot, external model, production executor, public tunnel or mobile session was tested.
Telegram callbacks and protected gateway transport are later stages.

decision_request.feedback: REJECT exact dbb99d1aa1334b9b2f60ced52db4fd0e0d3583ce: main.py _reconcile_managed_continuity_background synchronously waits on run_coroutine_threadsafe(reconcile_operations(...)).result() after runtime.reconcile_all. Launcher recovery awaits sequential Git/executor I/O, so one stalled operation prevents the next ordinary continuity tick for every project. Independent exact-code probe held one launcher recovery pending and observed only one healthy-project tick across 24 configured intervals (120 ms with 5 ms cadence). This violates scoped failure isolation even while ASGI remains responsive. Decouple launcher recovery from continuity cadence: maintain at most one owned ASGI-loop future, observe completion/errors without waiting in the continuity worker, and cleanly stop/cancel it during shutdown. Add regression keeping recovery pending while unrelated continuity ticks continue, with no overlapping launcher recoveries. 60 independent non-native/security checks otherwise passed; earlier authorization, session receipt, cancellation proof and stop-recovery findings are fixed. No production Bot/model integration is claimed.
